name: Adobe Firefly — Audio/Video (Media)
description: Audio/Video (Media) generation for Adobe Firefly Services (firefly-api.adobe.io): a MediaGenerationPort + adapter for text-to-video, image-to-video, audio/video translation, speech, and sound effects over the adobe-firefly-core foundation. Async and LONG (minutes) via FireflyJobPort; webhook job_mode strongly recommended. Partner models (Veo/Runway/Kling/ElevenLabs) are opaque model ids where entitled — no partner SDKs.

questions.prompt: Acknowledge partner-model routing (Veo/Runway/Kling/ElevenLabs as opaque model ids where entitled)?

checklist: Confirm the Audio/Video API entitlement + scope on your Adobe Developer Console project

Verify the current endpoints/payloads against Adobe docs — Firefly paths version frequently (this scaffold posts to the async /v3/videos/*-async and /v3/audio/*-async endpoints, which return a job to await)
Long jobs (minutes): prefer webhook job_mode and raise ADOBE_WEBHOOK_TIMEOUT_MS; if polling, raise ADOBE_JOB_POLL_INTERVAL_MS to scale the poll interval up for these long jobs
Provide presigned input (image for imageToVideo, source media for translateAudioVideo) + output hrefs — use core passthrough or install an adobe-firefly-storage-* addon
Set the default model via ADOBE_FIREFLY_MEDIA_MODEL; pass a per-call model to override
Partner models (Veo/Runway/Kling/ElevenLabs) are passed as opaque model ids where your entitlement allows — no partner SDKs are bundled
